import pandas as pd
from datetime import timedelta

def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    app_events = inputs["app_events"].copy()
    
    # Sort by user_id, event_ts, event_id
    app_events = app_events.sort_values(
        by=["user_id", "event_ts", "event_id"],
        ignore_index=True
    )
    
    sessions = []
    
    # Process per user
    for user_id, user_group in app_events.groupby("user_id", sort=False):
        user_events = user_group.reset_index(drop=True)
        session_num = 0
        open_session = None
        
        for idx, row in user_events.iterrows():
            event_ts = row["event_ts"]
            event_type = row["event_type"]
            
            is_activity = event_type in ["view", "click", "logout"]
            is_logout = event_type == "logout"
            is_heartbeat = event_type == "heartbeat"
            
            if is_activity:
                # Determine if we need to start a new session
                start_new_session = False
                
                if open_session is None:
                    # No open session, must start new
                    start_new_session = True
                else:
                    # Check if time since last activity > 30 minutes
                    time_since_last_activity = event_ts - open_session["last_activity_ts"]
                    if time_since_last_activity > timedelta(minutes=30):
                        start_new_session = True
                
                if start_new_session:
                    # Close previous session if exists
                    if open_session is not None:
                        sessions.append(open_session)
                    
                    # Start new session
                    session_num += 1
                    open_session = {
                        "user_id": user_id,
                        "session_num": session_num,
                        "session_start": event_ts,
                        "session_end": event_ts,  # Will be updated, but initialize
                        "last_activity_ts": event_ts,
                        "event_count": 1,
                        "heartbeat_count": 0
                    }
                else:
                    # Join existing session
                    open_session["event_count"] += 1
                    open_session["last_activity_ts"] = event_ts
                    open_session["session_end"] = event_ts
                
                # Handle logout
                if is_logout:
                    # Session ends at this logout event
                    open_session["session_end"] = event_ts
                    sessions.append(open_session)
                    open_session = None
            
            elif is_heartbeat:
                # Heartbeat only joins if session is open and time condition met
                if open_session is not None:
                    time_since_last_activity = event_ts - open_session["last_activity_ts"]
                    if time_since_last_activity <= timedelta(minutes=30):
                        # Heartbeat joins the session
                        open_session["event_count"] += 1
                        open_session["heartbeat_count"] += 1
                        # NOTE: heartbeat does NOT update last_activity_ts
                # else: drop heartbeat
        
        # Close any remaining open session
        if open_session is not None:
            sessions.append(open_session)
    
    if sessions:
        result_df = pd.DataFrame(sessions)
        result_df = result_df[
            ["user_id", "session_num", "session_start", "session_end",
             "event_count", "heartbeat_count"]
        ]
    else:
        result_df = pd.DataFrame(columns=[
            "user_id", "session_num", "session_start", "session_end",
            "event_count", "heartbeat_count"
        ])
    
    return {"user_sessions": result_df}
